major_events: In 第001章 肉身十重, Fang Han, a servant in the Fang household, secretly observes the family's martial arts training to learn the fundamentals of physical cultivation.
In 第004章 九窍金丹, Fang Han saves the drowning rogue practitioner Bai Haichan from the Longyuan River and receives the Nine-Aperture Golden Elixir and the Map of the Underworld.
In 第012章 鹤仙子, Fang Han refines the Myriad Beast Token using his blood and earns the trust of He Xianzi, a spiritual crane belonging to Fang Qingxue.
In 第022章 飞剑, Fang Han interacts with the royal princes and princesses of the Da离 Empire, displaying his developing physical strength and observing their flying swords.
In 第030章 斩首成功, Fang Han utilizes his mental force to manipulate the Spirit Wind Sword, successfully decapitating the Pink Prince and claiming his magical treasures.
In 第048章 瞬杀大法, Mo Shuai intervenes in a battle in the Underground World, showing the lethal speed of the Instant Kill method and offering swords to Fang Han.
In 第070章 发誓, Hua Tiandu confiscates Fang Han's Seven-Fiends Gourd, prompting Fang Han to make a ten-year vow on the Celestial Execution Stage to defeat him.
In 第088章 终于成了！, Fang Han successfully breaks through the boundary of the Mortal Realm to enter the Supernatural Realm, developing his first strand of magical power.
In 第100章 第一名, Fang Han wins the first place in the Mountain River Ranking tournament, securing a major sect reward and receiving the Wood Emperor technique from Fang Qingxue.
In 第108章 木皇真气, Fang Han refines the pure Wood Emperor's Vigor on the Lunhui Peak to establish the foundation of his Wood Emperor technique.
In 第119章 五狱王鼎, Fang Han and Long Xuan clash with Taiyi sect disciples in a sea cavern and seize the high-quality magic furnace known as the Five-Hell King Cauldron.
In 第141章 电母转世, Fang Han drops the Six-Yang Sacred Water onto the World Tree splinter, initiating a strong sign of life and growth in the mystical wood.
In 第156章 囚禁, Fang Han breaks through to the 3rd stage of Supernatural Powers (Vigor/Gangqi Realm) under extreme pressure from Seven-Leaf Demon Lord.
In 第169章 一体镇压, Fang Han uses the combined power of the cauldron and Yan's soul to suppress and capture six Taiyi sect True disciples in one go.
In 第172章 尸骸，种子，金丹, Fang Han and Yan enter the Taiyuan Immortal Mansion's time-dilated inner chamber, discovering the corpse and golden elixir of a deceased cultivator.
In 第184章 风白羽, the Yuhua Sect Leader wind Baiyu uses the Battle God Whip to shatter the Nine-Yang Demon God's projection and rescues Fang Han from the Mansion.
In 第203章 战胜, Fang Han defeats the true disciple Wanluo in a high-stakes duel, successfully seizing his auxiliary magical pill and winning their bet.
In 第228章 阿鼻之门, Fang Han uses the pure Yang energy of the newly purchased Great Sanskrit Bright Boat to restore Yan's power and unlock the Abi Gate of the Underworld Map.
In 第233章 金丹到手, Fang Han and Yan capture two of the Four Great Bandits (Ciyue Dao and Miexing Dao) and extract their golden elixirs using the power of the Abi Gate.
In 第248章 末日天灾, Fang Han enters the Five Elements Land, finding himself in the same region as the resurrected Taiyi sect members who were previously captured by him.
character_state_transitions: Fang Han transitions from a humble horse servant in the Fang household to an Outer Disciple of the Yuhua Sect in 第014章.
Fang Han transitions from an Outer Disciple to an Inner Disciple of the Yuhua Sect after presenting a Shura's bone spike to the Inner Gate Hall in 第051章.
Fang Han transitions from a Mortal Realm martial artist to a Supernatural Realm cultivator upon developing mana in 第088章.
Fang Han transitions from the 2nd stage of Supernatural Powers (Zhenqi) to the 3rd stage (Gangqi) under pressure from the Seven-Leaf Demon Lord in 第156章.
Fang Han transitions from the 3rd stage of Supernatural Powers (Gangqi) to the 4th stage (Yinyang) under the guidance of the mysterious person in the Taiyuan Mansion in 第176章.
Fang Han transitions from the 4th stage of Supernatural Powers (Yinyang) to the 5th stage (Tianren) after spending 15 years in the time-dilated chamber in 第179章.
Yan (蛟龙 阎) transitions from a dormant, silent dragon soul to an awakened consciousness capable of communicating with Fang Han in 第034章.
Wanluo (万罗) transitions from a proud, authoritative True Disciple to a humiliated loser stripped of his magical pill and defeated by Fang Han in 第203章.
He Xianzi (鹤仙子) transitions from a free-roaming spiritual crane to a bound mount and close ally of Fang Han after the Myriad Beast Token is refined in 第012章.

The World Tree fragment transitions from a dry, dead piece of ancient wood to an active sapling capable of drawing immortal energy from the void after absorbing Six-Yang Sacred Water in 第141章 and 第158章.
The six Taiyi Sect True Disciples transition from arrogant patrollers of the seas to sealed captives imprisoned inside Fang Han's Five-Hell King Cauldron in 第169章.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Nine-Aperture Golden Elixir solid-state absorption (九窍金丹)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A rare elixir that lodges inside the cultivator's heart, gradually melting and continuously strengthening the physical body, bones, and internal organs over time to lay a perfect foundation.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Blood-refining Magic Items (滴血祭炼)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A method by which even martial artists in the Mortal Realm can bind and control magic items (like the Myriad Beast Token) by using blood to connect their consciousness with the item's array.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Water-method Alchemy (水法炼丹 / 淘洗)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A unique alchemy technique of the Underworld Sect where the user washes materials (like Heavenly Demons) using the river water of the Underworld Map (forgotten-love water) to purify them into pills without using fire.

long_form_mechanisms.name: World Tree Spiritual Energy Conversion (世界之树汲取)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The sapling of the World Tree extends its roots into the void, directly tapping into the energy of the Immortal Realm and continuously outputting pure spiritual energy and generating high-quality pills (like Yuanying pills) for the cultivator.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Time-dilation Field of Taiyuan Mansion (太元仙府时间流速)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A specialized pocket dimension created by an ancient immortal where time inside passes at a rate of 360 years for every 1 year in the outside world, allowing rapid cultivation but risking starvation.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Five Elements Elemental Synergy (五帝大魔五行循环)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme cultivation method (Five Emperors Great Demon Art) where the user collects and refines elemental essences (wood, fire, soil, metal, water) to form a self-sustaining cycle, boosting magic power exponentially.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Opening the Second Brain/Sea (第二脑海)
long_form_mechanisms.description: An advanced technique from the Panwu Great Strength Art where the user uses massive amounts of physical battle spirit and slaughter aura to expand and open a secondary spiritual sea in their head to double their mana capacity.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Abi Gate Hell-torment suppression (阿鼻之门)
long_form_mechanisms.description: An advanced function of the Underworld Map unlocked using pure Yang energy, which summons a gate of hell that can draw in, torture, and refine the golden elixirs or souls of captured enemies.

continuity_observations: The origin of the 九窍金丹 and the 蛟伏黄泉图 from the deceased Bai Haichan in Chapter 4 remains the core driver of Fang Han's cultivation and his secret identity throughout the entire chunk.

The conflict between Fang Han and Hua Tiandu starts in Chapter 35 with their first meeting, escalates in Chapter 70 with the confiscation of the Gourd, and continues to be the main deadline driving Fang Han's rapid cultivation.

The relationship between Fang Han and Fang Qingxue remains complex; she suspects he has the Underworld Map in Chapter 45, yet she continues to protect him and offers him the 青帝木皇功 in Chapter 103 to foster his growth.
The role of He Xianzi (the spiritual crane) is sustained as a bridge between Fang Han and the outer world, from early transport to her training under Fang Han's guidance in Chapter 205.
The 世界之树 fragment, first acquired from the merchant in Chapter 131, continues to grow and becomes a critical utility that solves Fang Han's resource needs by generating Yuanying pills.
The 六大真人 of the Taiyi Sect, who are first captured by Fang Han in Chapter 169, reappear as freed but frustrated members in the Five Elements Land in Chapter 248, maintaining their grudge against him.
The secret of the 'forgotten-love water' (忘情水) is introduced by Yan in Chapter 54, discussed by Long Xuan in Chapter 129, and finally traded to the ghost emperor in Chapter 236.
The four great bandits (Ciyue, Miexing, Zhuxian, Zhetian) are introduced early in the lore of the oceans, and Fang Han eventually battles and captures two of them (Ciyue and Miexing) in Chapter 233.
style_observations: Underdog Social Defiance: The protagonist's thoughts and actions are heavily shaped by his origins as a servant, resulting in a fierce pride and refusal to accept charity or condescension from noble-born elites (e.g. Mo Shuai in Chapter 49).
Numeric Hyperbole in Combat: Frequent use of quantified measurements of power (e.g. 'horses of strength' / '玄黄烈马之力') to denote combat efficiency, scaling from a few horses to millions of horses.

Internal Dialogue with the Mentor Spirit: Extensive expository banter between Fang Han and the dragon spirit Yan, serving as a tool to explain cultivation mechanics and ancient history directly to the reader.
Cinematic Escalation of Spell Visuals: Battles are described with highly visual, elemental imagery (e.g. giant thunder gods, flaming phoenixes, water dragons) that expand to cover miles of landscape.

Decisive Ruthlessness (杀伐果断): The narrative style highlights swift execution and immediate harvesting of spoils (such as stripping corpses of magic bags and elixirs) following a victory, reflecting a harsh survivalist world.
Serialized Cliffhangers: Chapter endings regularly conclude with a dramatic breakthrough, a sudden ambush, or a shocking revelation to maintain narrative tension and reader interest.

power_system.power_metric: 玄黄烈马之力 (Strength of Xuanhuang Horses)

originality_risks: The 'Horses of Strength' Power-Scaling Metric: Using a fixed, linear multiplier (e.g. 100,000 horses of power) to measure magical strength can feel overly game-like and reduce the sense of mystical wonder.
The Hidden Mastermind/Ancient Soul in the Item Trope: Having the dragon spirit Yan live inside the Underworld Map to teach the protagonist secret arts is a highly common trope in Chinese web novels.

The Arrogant True Disciple Rivalry: The setup of a prestigious, arrogant elder disciple (Hua Tiandu) acting as a massive early wall and setting a multi-year deadline for a duel is a standard narrative formula in sect-based xianxia.

Resource Generation Cheat (World Tree): Allowing the protagonist to automatically generate infinite high-level pills (Yuanying pills) via the World Tree reduces the difficulty of cultivation and limits the tension around resource scarcity.
